claim: When both _cookiePath and _cookieBrowser are null (no cookies configured), activeCookieSource incorrectly returns the string 'browser' instead of null, because null != 'none' is true in Dart.

The --merge-output-format argument is never applied for dual-stream downloads because the code reads the extension from an yt-dlp output TEMPLATE path ('%(title)s.%(ext)s'), producing the literal string '%(ext)s' which never matches the allowed container list.

looksLikePlaylist returns true for ordinary URLs that merely contain the substring 'list=' (for example a checklist query parameter or an empty list= parameter), causing single-video pages to be treated as playlists.

Any error text containing the bare substrings 'outdated' or 'signature' is classified as an outdated yt-dlp extractor and surfaces an 'Extractor Update Required' message, even when the real cause is unrelated.

The desktop DownloadProvider's _throttledNotify is leading-edge-only with no trailing flush, so the last progress update in a burst can be dropped and the UI progress bar can freeze until the next yt-dlp event arrives.

findDownloadedFile's idMatches branch can never succeed under the default -o template because the on-disk filename is the video title, not the composite DownloadItem.id, so the finder falls back to a 4-word title match that can select the wrong file in a crowded download folder.
startDownload silently no-ops when the same URL is already active, with no user-visible feedback, so a second tap appears broken.
